Summary cost header: 'Typical current international values and ranges (2012 US$, 1 EUR = 1.3 US$)'; O&M row 'US$ 2012'. Table 10 (project capex) states no year - recorded as 2012_USD on the strength of the summary header; the figures are nominal announcement-year costs (2012-2013). Table 11: 'US$2009/barrel'. Table 12: nominal US$/bbl of 2011 or 2012 as printed per row. Canadian refinery costs (text): no year; 2012_USD per the summary header.

Main file: whole-refinery and whole-upgrader values only. The brief gives NO numbers by refinery complexity class, so refinery_hydroskimming / refinery_conversion / refinery_deep-conversion receive nothing directly; all refinery values are on 'refinery_oil' (a whole refinery of unstated or mixed complexity - US fleet averages, company figures and individual projects). Processes: US fleet efficiency (Table 8 and text, 2006 and 2008); utilization (world 2012, US 2002-2012); US sector emissions per bbl (2010, 2011); Karras emissions per m3 crude by feed quality; operating costs - Table 11 'Other costs' by year, Table 12 by refiner (19 cases), IEA averages by region; capex - Table 10 split by technology into refinery projects (8 cases), oil-sands upgraders (3 cases, reactor_integrated-upgrader) and the bitumen upgrader-refinery with CCS (reactor_integrated-upgrader-ccs), each with capacity, total and per-b/d cost; global additions 2011-2016 (31.9 k$ per b/d); new refinery in Canada (65.7 and 93.9 k$ per b/d). Sidecars (not loaded): _efficiency-by-product (Table 8 allocation), _operating-costs-table11 (full table incl. marketing and energy), _fuel-use-table9 (units defective), _configurations (Table 4 yields by complexity, Table 7 US configuration), _context, _projections. Omitted: Tables 1-3 (capacity, throughput and Chinese project statistics), Tables 5-6 (product yields), Figs. 1-3.
